programs.name: Computer Science BSc
programs.a_level_offer: A*A*A, to include A* in Mathematics
programs.ib_offer: 39 points, with 7, 6, 6 in three Higher Level subjects, including 7 in HL Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches only)
programs.ap_offer: Typical equivalent of A*A*A: five APs in separate subjects at 5,5,5,5,5, plus the US High School Diploma (no GPA minimum). Department of Computer Science (all courses) requires AP Calculus BC at grade 5; AP Calculus AB is not an acceptable alternative. SAT 1340 (min 540 per section) or ACT 28-29 also needed for the GCSE English/Maths equivalent.
programs.required_subjects: A-level Mathematics or equivalent, at A*. Further Maths recommended, not essential; only the top three A-levels are considered
programs.admissions_test: TMUA (the page says all 2026-27 applicants must take it unless eligible for a contextual offer; exact required score not published)
programs.toefl_note: English language Band A. TOEFL iBT taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 87 with at least 21 in Listening, 21 in Writing, 22 in Reading and 23 in Speaking. Taken from 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 4.5 with at least 4.5 in each component.
programs.english_note: Warwick English language Band A: IELTS Academic 6.0 with 5.5 in each component; PTE Academic 60 with no less than 59 in any communicative skill; Duolingo 110 with 100 in each component (accepted for September 2026 entry only, per the page).
programs.notes: Contextual offer: A*AA including A in Mathematics; IB 38 including 6 in HL Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches only). Start date 27 September 2027. TMUA wording on the course page refers to 2026-27 applicants. Fee: GBP 37,310 is the 2027-28 column (Band 2) of Warwick's overseas fee table (https://warwick.ac.uk/services/finance/studentfinance/fees/overseasfees/); the course page itself says 2027-28 overseas fees 'have not been set' and shows the 2026-27 Band 2 rate of GBP 35,530, so treat 37,310 as provisional. AP route: https://warwick.ac.uk/study/international/countryinformation/northamerica/usa/usa-entry-requirements/ (Warwick says its undergraduate entry requirements are under review for 2027/28 and the published ones are a guide only; US High School Diploma alone is not enough for direct entry). English: https://warwick.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/applying/english-language-requirements/ (page last updated 04 Feb 2026 and written for September 2026 entry; tests within two years and one month of the start).

programs.name: Economics BSc
programs.a_level_offer: A*AA, including A in Mathematics (plus GCSE English Language grade 6/B)
programs.ib_offer: 38 points, including 6 in HL Mathematics (Analysis and Approaches or Applications and Interpretation); plus GCSE English 6/B or IB English A grade 5, HL English B grade 5 or SL English B grade 6
programs.ap_offer: Typical equivalent of A*AA: four APs in separate subjects at 5,5,5,5, plus the US High School Diploma (no GPA minimum). Department of Economics (all courses) requires AP Calculus BC at grade 5; AP Calculus AB is not an acceptable alternative. SAT 1340 (min 540 per section) or ACT 28-29 also needed for the GCSE English/Maths equivalent.
programs.required_subjects: A-level Mathematics or equivalent (A). Further Maths and Economics are accepted but have no special status; only the top three A-levels are considered
programs.admissions_test: TMUA (optional; highest scorers considered for a reduced AAA offer; required level not published; applicants without TMUA still considered)
programs.toefl_note: English language Band C. TOEFL iBT taken before 21 Jan 2026 (old 0-120 scale): 100 with at least 21 in Listening, 21 in Writing, 22 in Reading and 23 in Speaking. Taken from 21 Jan 2026 (new 1-6 scale): 5.0 with at least 4.5 in each component.
programs.english_note: Warwick English language Band C: IELTS Academic 7.0 with 6.5 in each component; PTE Academic 75 with no less than 59 in any communicative skill; Duolingo 130 with 120 in each component (accepted for September 2026 entry only, per the page).
programs.notes: Contextual offer: AAB including A in Mathematics. The page says changes to the course are planned for 2027 entry and are awaiting approval. Duration 3 years (4 with study abroad). Start date 27 September 2027. Fee: GBP 37,310 is the 2027-28 column (Band 2) of Warwick's overseas fee table (https://warwick.ac.uk/services/finance/studentfinance/fees/overseasfees/); the course page itself says 2027-28 overseas fees 'have not been set' and shows the 2026-27 Band 2 rate of GBP 35,530, so treat 37,310 as provisional. AP route: https://warwick.ac.uk/study/international/countryinformation/northamerica/usa/usa-entry-requirements/ (Warwick says its undergraduate entry requirements are under review for 2027/28 and the published ones are a guide only; US High School Diploma alone is not enough for direct entry). English: https://warwick.ac.uk/study/undergraduate/applying/english-language-requirements/ (page last updated 04 Feb 2026 and written for September 2026 entry; tests within two years and one month of the start).

programs.name: Mechanical Engineering BEng
programs.a_level_offer: AAA, to include Mathematics and Physics
programs.ib_offer: 36 points, to include 6 in HL Mathematics and 6 in HL Physics

programs.required_subjects: A-level Mathematics and Physics (applicants with a strong profile studying only one of the two may be considered)
